reconstructed_git_bundle.boundary: Hash-verified reconstruction seed only. It predates the later GitLab backend/configuration layer and is not represented as the final GitLab tree.

rehydrated_source_corpus.boundary: Private recovery corpus metadata only. The corpus itself, custody material and private evidence are not approved for public Git.

gitlab_chronology_anchors.provenance: Two independent pre-block GitLab-generated Duo/work-item notifications recorded this protected-main SHA.
gitlab_chronology_anchors.boundary: This is the last defensible pre-block GitLab main anchor currently established off-platform. It does not prove that no later commit existed before the account block.

notification_event_graph.boundary: Email notifications support an offline event graph of MR/work-item/pipeline activity but do not recreate complete GitLab database rows, discussions, approvals, artifacts or secret/configuration state.

capabilities.byte_identity: Pre-block parity salvage recorded exact blob identity before GitHub merge.
capabilities.boundary: This classification applies to the protocol file only; it does not imply parity for GitLab Duo platform/session state.

capabilities.boundary: These items must be recovered from authenticated GitLab state or an official export, or deliberately re-created/reset where appropriate. They must never be inferred from notifications.

reconciliation_policy: Never reconstruct unavailable exact GitLab bytes from email snippets, rendered Pages, screenshots or memory.
Never publish the private recovery bundle, rehydrated source corpus, custody material, private evidence, credentials or secret values to public GitHub.
Treat the 6 September reconstructed bundle as a verified historical recovery seed, not the final GitLab tree.
Preserve all 575 conflicting recovered path groups until source-level reconciliation; never select canonical versions by timestamp or last-write-wins.
When authenticated GitLab access or an official export returns, compare exact GitLab objects against the then-current GitHub outage-period state additively.
Do not force-reset or overwrite newer GitHub continuity work with restored historical GitLab material.
Require exact-head Outage backend parity, PD release acceptance and Publication integrity gates before any merge of backend-recovery controls.
